label: Distinct actual dependence is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1, from actual grounding
description: If x depends for its being on a distinct c and both are actual concreta at w, the OPEN distinct-relata bridge makes c ground x at w, and the OPEN grounding-to-priority bridge makes c simply prior to x. Plain conditional composition of two existing bridges; its value is that it reaches priority without STMT-INDEPENDENCE-ALLOWS-BEING-WITHOUT and without the unrestricted dependence-to-grounding bridge, so it stays consistent with a reflexive reading of DependsForBeing (Control.ReflexiveCompatible). Each bridge is needed (Control.OmitDistinctGround, Control.OmitGroundingPriority). The Comparator-checked corollary actualNonmutualOfDistinct gives STMT-NONMUTUAL-DEPENDENCE-SUFFICES-FOR-PRIORITY only for actual concrete relata, not unscoped. Conditional consequence only; neither bridge is established.
